name: Task
about: General project task.
title: "[Task] "
labels: task
assignees: ""
---

## Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the task.

**Example:**
Refactor the authentication service to improve code readability and maintainability.

## Objectives

List the objectives or subtasks required to complete this task.

**Example:**

- [ ] Refactor the authentication service.
- [ ] Update unit tests.
- [ ] Verify that all existing tests pass.
- [ ] Update the documentation if necessary.

## Expected Outcome

Describe the expected result once the task is completed.

**Example:**
The authentication service is easier to maintain, follows the project's coding standards, and all tests pass successfully.

## Notes

Include any additional information that may help complete the task.

**Examples:**
- Related issue or pull request.
- Dependencies on other tasks.
- References to documentation.
- Technical considerations or constraints.
